summary: Sapience is a European-based contact center SaaS provider looking to add native multilingual automation for agent assist and ticket triage. Primary goal: keep agent-facing latency low (p95 < 300ms for short suggestions) while supporting bursty traffic during marketing campaigns. They require EU data residency and strong audit/KMS controls. Interested in Redwood Dedicated or Private for predictable throughput and residency.
notes: Customer quote from demo: 'We need replies that feel native to each locale — tone, formality, polite phrasing vary by country.'
Use-case detail: live agent assist uses short-completion suggestions + one-click tool-calling (create internal ticket, escalate to Tier-2 with prefilled context).
Performance reqs: p95 latency target for suggestions <= 300ms; end-to-end ticket summarization async SLA < 30s for <10k daily tickets, batch summarization for nightly rollover.
Routing: prefer geo-routing to EU clusters, fallback to host in NA only if encryption-in-transit + approved processing addendum present.
Quality controls: want per-locale eval sets (20k labeled messages total) and regression alerts tied to sample prompts.
Cost sensitivity: cares about token economics during spikes — asked about Optimize recommendations (quantization + batching) to reduce per-token cost.
Integrations: Zendesk (primary), Salesforce for escalations, internal tooling via function-calls/webhooks. Need example tool-calling doc (sent link above).
Security: infosec asked for SOC2 report, ISO certs, and a red-team schedule — Rina to provide SOC2 URL and roadmap for pen-test dates.
POC plan proposed: 4-week pilot in Redwood Dedicated (EU region) with a small reserved pool for predictable latency; week 3 run 48-hr 10x spike test; evaluate quality and cost metrics.
